content: {"paper_id":"lab-9d85eae3a12f","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"partial-label-learning","exact_quote":"This paper proposes a novel framework for partial label learning in HSI classification, namely unlabeled data guided partial label learning (UPLL).","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"论文明确提出偏标记学习任务：每个HSI像素的候选标签集合包含真标签，仅一个候选为真。"},{"keyword_id":"semi-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"we conduct the semi-supervised label propagation","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"方法利用半监督标签传播，结合少量已标注样本与未标注测试样本来学习。"},{"keyword_id":"pseudo-label-self-training","exact_quote":"we select qualified original training samples and unlabeled testing samples with high confident predictions to disambiguate and expand the original training set","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"将高置信预测样本筛选后加入/扩展训练集，作为后续训练信号，属于伪标签与自训练。"},{"keyword_id":"hyperspectral-images","exact_quote":"Hyperspectral Image Classification","evidence_field":"title","reason_zh":"研究对象为高光谱图像分类。"},{"keyword_id":"weakly-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"partial label learning often provides a candidate label set that contains the ground-truth label for each pixel in an HSI","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"每个像素仅给出含真标签的候选标签集合，属于候选歧义/不精确监督，并作为核心研究条件。"}],"abstentions":[],"input_issues":[]}
